name: SS TANK - 500 LITER
summary: The SS TANK – 500 LITER is a premium-grade stainless steel water storage tank designed to provide safe, hygienic, and reliable water storage for residential, commercial, and institutional applications.
intro: The SS Tank – 500 Liter is a premium-quality stainless steel water storage solution designed for safe, hygienic, and long-lasting water storage. Built using high-grade food-grade stainless steel, it offers exceptional resistance to rust, corrosion, and contamination, ensuring a continuous supply of clean and fresh water. Its robust construction makes it suitable for residential homes, apartments, commercial establishments, restaurants, schools, hospitals, and industrial applications. The seamless design minimizes the risk of leakage while the smooth inner surface prevents the growth of algae, bacteria, and unpleasant odors, helping maintain water purity. Unlike conventional plastic tanks, the SS Tank preserves the natural quality of stored water without affecting its taste or odor. Engineered for durability, it withstands harsh weather conditions and requires minimal maintenance, making it a reliable and cost-effective investment. With a 500-liter storage capacity, the SS Tank is ideal for medium to large water storage requirements, providing dependable performance, superior hygiene, and an extended service life. Its elegant stainless steel finish also adds a modern look to any installation while ensuring maximum strength and durability.
features: Premium Food-Grade Stainless Steel: Manufactured using high-quality stainless steel for maximum strength, hygiene, and corrosion resistance.
Large 500-Liter Capacity: Ideal for homes, apartments, offices, restaurants, and commercial establishments requiring dependable water storage.
Rust & Leak Resistant: Seamless construction minimizes leakage while providing exceptional resistance to rust and environmental wear.
Hygienic Water Storage: Smooth stainless steel surface prevents algae, bacterial growth, and unpleasant odors, preserving water quality.
Low Maintenance & Long Service Life: Easy to clean, requires minimal maintenance, and delivers years of reliable performance in all weather conditions.
Modern & Durable Design: Sleek stainless steel finish complements contemporary installations while withstanding harsh outdoor and indoor environments.
